text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I brought the injured Admire Groove to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"An injury like this...
Making a big deal out of it is more of a burden, honestly..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...... I can treat this myself,
so there's no need to intervene.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Once that's taken care of,
let's continue our training.
choice_data_list: Just to be safe, let's take a rest for now.
Yeah, as long as it's treated properly.
Yeah, once it's been properly treated, that is.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Once that's taken care of,
let's continue our training.
choice_data_list: Just to be safe, let's take a rest for now.
Yeah, as long as it's treated properly.
Yeah, once it's been properly treated, that is.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I know myself best...! Trainer, you're not a stranger, are you—
choice_data_list: Even so, you're still my trainee.
Even so, you're still my trainee.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
If that's how it is, I have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't mean to cause you trouble or anything.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please get back to your work.
I'm going to... sleep for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worried about her injury,
I decided to leave Admire Groove in peace.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(This is strange...
I should have treated it thoroughly...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"For the next training session,
please make it an intense one to make up for today."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm clocking out for today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Think you can keep going like this?
Think you can keep going like this?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...As long as I don't move it excessively.
Well then, I'm off.
